profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer: Tech Lead at Coolfire

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer: Tech Lead
positions.description: Skills: Git · Software Development · JavaScript · Continuous Delivery (CD) · Web Development · Front-end Development · Leadership · React.js · Continuous Integration (CI) · Teamwork · Web Applications · Project Management · Full-Stack Development · Project Planning · Node.js · MongoDB · TypeScript · GraphQL

positions.title: Computer Science Tutor
positions.description:
* Assist students on the Java, C++, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, SQL and PHP languages
* Helped building simulations and games with Java using Greenfoot
* Aided on building static websites and basic web applications using HTML, CSS and JavaScript
* Tutored implementations of the PHP and Java languages in conjunction with SQL to manage databases 
* Other subjects tutored are Pre-Calculus, Business Calculus and Calculus I

positions.title: Full Stack Web Developer
positions.description:
* Building HypeClash.com with Wordpress using a custom theme made from scratch
* Built and normalized database tables using Apache servers and SQL
* Customized plugins to adapt to different situations using PHP and the Materialize frontend framework

positions.title: Web Development Intern
positions.description:
* Database migration from Orchestrate to Firebase
* Design and implement data-capture process from users for feedback and statistical data using Firebase and NodeJS
* Participated in building RESTful API using MongoDB
* Exposure to AngularJS

volunteerExperiences.description: Worked as a Volunteer for the Votojoven group. Elections in Venezuela - it did not matter if they were presidential or parliamentary - were being distorted in a way that people stopped voting. With a national situation as it was - and still is - this needed to change. The goal of the Votojoven group is to raise awareness about how the process of voting is and to reduce the abstinence rate during the process through talks, interviews and distributing flyers.
Worked as a volunteer for Fundana, a home for foster children, over summer break in Caracas, Venezuela.
